note: Both sets correctly capture the near-linear variation of pitch sensitivity with blade-pitch angle in Region 3 and the rated mechanical power of 5.296610 MW with supporting quotes. Set B, however, repeats the rated-power claim a second time without its conditions, adding no information. Neither set extracts the rated rotor speed (12.1 rpm) or any of the Table 7-1 sensitivity data, which are the main engineering content of the page.
remarks: Both extractions are very sparse: the page's central data (Table 7-1, 15 rows of wind speed / pitch angle / dP/dtheta, plus rated rotor speed Omega_0 = 12.1 rpm and the frozen-wake linearization assumption) is entirely omitted by both sets. Set B's third claim is a verbatim restatement of its second claim minus the 'rated' condition, a pattern suggesting deduplication and condition propagation issues in that extractor.
